description: Promotion gate for SourceOS fog-node images and for Noetica desktop installs. Both targets run the same five checks because both fail the same way: a payload that starts, answers one request, and then cannot reach its control plane.

checks.name: supervisor-alive
checks.description: The node supervisor reached its ready state and has stayed there for the probe window.

checks.name: local-api-200
checks.description: The local control endpoint answers with a 200 and reports the payload version this transaction wrote.

checks.name: state-store-readable
checks.description: The persistent state store opens and its schema version is one this payload can serve. A payload that boots but cannot read the state it inherited is a brick with a login prompt.

checks.name: control-plane-reachable
checks.description: The target reached its control plane at least once. Blocking on purpose: an edge node that cannot be reached cannot be remotely rolled back, so promoting it converts a recoverable fault into a site visit.

checks.name: fallback-slot-bootable
checks.description: The other slot still holds a digest-verified payload with a non-zero boot priority. Checked BEFORE promotion because promotion is the moment the previous payload stops being the guaranteed way back.

watchdogs.description: Petted only by the health loop after a full passing check sweep, never on a timer. A supervisor that pets on a schedule proves the supervisor is alive and says nothing about the payload.

Independent SoC timer. Longer than the software timeout so the software watchdog gets the first, attributable word; it exists for the case where the kernel wedges and the software watchdog can never run to fire.
